answers.core: This would be something that any user would find handy if they want to make use of has_method, and duck typing is something central to the design of gdscript itself- so it makes sense to have extra functionality to make the duck typing workflow more convenient.
answers.workaround: I don't think this is something most users can implement easily, and certainly not something that can be done without an in-depth knowledge of the inner workings of the Godot editor.
